elements.label: Full Jira Product Discovery screen recording dimming to black

pattern.description: Right after the closing line 'good luck!', the whole static screen recording fades uniformly toward black over about a third of a second. There is no scale, blur or camera move.
pattern.why_premium: A short dip to black that starts just after the last spoken word ends the video cleanly instead of with an abrupt cut; it is standard practice rather than a distinctive premium move.

build_hint.gsap: Black overlay over the final scene: gsap.fromTo(overlay, {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.33, ease: 'none'}) (or 'power1.in'), starting ~0.2 s after the last narration word.
build_hint.remotion: Scene opacity = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 10], [1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) at 30fps over a black <AbsoluteFill>; linear, no spring.

notes: Only b01 is listed: the OCR boxes b02-b20 are text inside the same frame that dims together, not separate elements. Packet end frame is mid-fade (still faintly visible).
